subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 1: revises Term 1 sounds; 'sp' (spill, spin, spot); segmenting and blending; letter-swap game

show.line: s and p together. sp, sp, spin! Spill, spin, spot.

rounds.prompt: Listen. sp, i, n. What word is it?
Swap the first sound! Spin. Change sp to t. What do we get?
Does it start with sp or s? Sort the pictures.

hints: Say s, then p, quickly. sp!
Listen to the start. Is it sp or just s?

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will read this word.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! It says spot. sp at the start.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's read it together. sp, o, t. Spot!

parent_line: Can read words starting with sp, like spin, spot and spill.
